t: 西西里人民反抗安茹国王查理一世，这就是所谓的西西里晚祷。
te: The people of Sicily rebel against the Angevin king Charles I, in what becomes known as the Sicilian Vespers.
dz: 西西里人民反抗安茹国王查理一世，这就是所谓的西西里晚祷。
de: The people of Sicily rebel against the Angevin king Charles I, in what becomes known as the Sicilian Vespers.

t: 阿拉贡的彼得三世从特拉帕尼登陆干预西西里卫斯珀斯人之战.
te: Peter III of Aragon lands at Trapani to intervene in the War of the Sicilian Vespers.
dz: 阿拉贡的彼得三世从特拉帕尼登陆干预西西里卫斯珀斯人之战.
de: Peter III of Aragon lands at Trapani to intervene in the War of the Sicilian Vespers.

t: 阿拉贡的彼得三世被封为巴勒莫的西西里国王.
te: Peter III of Aragon is proclaimed King of Sicily in Palermo.
dz: 阿拉贡的彼得三世被封为巴勒莫的西西里国王.
de: Peter III of Aragon is proclaimed King of Sicily in Palermo.

t: 威尔士最后一位本土亲王Llywelyn ap Gruffudd被击毙于瓦莱斯中区Builth …
te: Llywelyn ap Gruffudd, the last native Prince of Wales, is killed at Cilmeri near Builth Wells in mid-Wales.
dz: 奥勒温桥之战:威尔士最后一位本土亲王Llywelyn ap Gruffudd被击毙于瓦莱斯中区Builth Wells附近的Cilmeri.
de: Battle of Orewin Bridge: Llywelyn ap Gruffudd, the last native Prince of Wales, is killed at Cilmeri near Builth Wells in mid-Wales.
